description.zh: 用于确保实际更改的资源和期望更改的资源是一致的，该值来自[CreateTrigger](~~415729~~)、[GetTrigger](~~415732~~)和[UpdateTrigger](~~415731~~)的响应。
description.en: This parameter is used to ensure that the modified resource is consistent with the resource to be modified. You can obtain the parameter value from the responses of [CreateTrigger](~~415729~~), [GetTrigger](~~415732~~), and [UpdateTrigger](~~415731~~) operations.
